title: TimeScope AI: Explore any day in history with AI, stories & archives | Product Hunt
excerpt: TimeScope AI is an AI-powered history platform that lets you explore any date through interactive timelines, AI stories, historical newspapers, photo archives, local history, museums, verified sources, quizzes, projects, certifications, and a public API. Built for students, teachers, researchers, and history enthusiasts, it makes discovering and understanding the past engaging, reliable, and accessible.
